meta.title: Dotilda · A question a day, a dot in your sky
meta.description: Dotilda is a gentle daily journaling app for the Mudita Kompakt and Android e-readers. One small question a day, a dot in your sky. Free, private, open source.
meta.ogDescription: A gentle daily journaling app for e-ink. Free, private, open source.

hero.label: Daily journaling for e‑ink · free and open source
hero.title: A question a day, a dot in your sky.
hero.lede: Dotilda asks you one small question each day. A line, a word or a tap is enough. Then you put the phone down.
hero.note: Made for the Mudita Kompakt and Android 11+ e‑readers. No account, no tracking, no ads.

device.aria: Dotilda on a Mudita Kompakt, asking: What made you feel calm today?
device.question: What made you feel calm today?

ritual.label: The ritual · under two minutes
ritual.title: One question, at the hour you choose. Then nothing.

steps.label: 1 · Dotilda asks
steps.title: A small question
steps.text: One gentle reminder a day, at your time. No feed, no inbox, nothing to catch up on.

steps.label: 2 · You answer
steps.title: A line is plenty
steps.text: Write a line, pick a word, choose tea or coffee. On heavy days, just tell her the weather inside.

steps.label: 3 · A dot appears
steps.title: Your sky fills up
steps.text: Each answer adds one dot to the year. It is drawn once, in ink, and stays still.

try.label: Try one
try.first: Tea or coffee kind of day?
try.meta: More than 200 questions in the app, so you never feel you are going round in circles.
try.done: That was my last one for today. Or just tell me the weather inside.

shapes.label: Eight ways to answer
shapes.title: Every answer gives its dot a shape.

formats.name: Inner weather
formats.text: Sun to storm, as a moon phase.

formats.name: This or that
formats.text: Tea or coffee kind of day?

formats.name: Letter to future me
formats.text: Sealed until the date you choose.

sky.label: Your sky
sky.title: Miss a day? Nothing breaks.
sky.lede: The whole year fits on one screen: twelve rows, one dot per day. An empty day is a tiny grey dot, a breath in the grid. No streak, no red, no guilt.

quotes.text: There you are. Your sky kept your place.
Seven days, seven dots. I’ll call this one Slow.
quotes.who: At the end of a journey

quotes.text: A cloudy start, a sunny finish. Rather well done.

sky.aria: A sample year of dots, from January to today, with a few quiet days and one constellation in March.

legend.journey: — a finished journey: “7 days to slow down”

promises.title: Yours alone
promises.text: No account. Everything stays on the device. Export or move your journal any time.

promises.title: Made for e‑ink
promises.text: Pure black on white, large type, no scrolling, no animation. Page with the volume keys.

promises.title: Rewards looking back
promises.text: Monthly and seasonal reviews, letters to future you, and your year as an EPUB book.

promises.title: Quiet by design
promises.text: One reminder a day, at your hour. No nudges, no rankings, no social feed.

promises.title: Breathe first
promises.text: spira, a one‑minute breathing break, plus a timer and stopwatch the Kompakt lacks.

promises.title: Free, for good
promises.text: No purchase, no subscription, no ads. Open source under Apache 2.0.

get.label: Get Dotilda
get.title: Tonight, she has a question for you.

steps.title: Download the APK
steps.text: From GitHub, always the latest version. The app tells you when a new one is out.

steps.title: Install it
steps.text: With Mudita Center on the Kompakt, or Obtainium on any Android 11+ e‑reader.

steps.title: Pick your hour
steps.text: Dotilda will knock once a day, never twice.

footer.fine: This page sets no cookies and counts no visitors. Like the app, it does not watch you.
